title: Arthas Menethil
summary: Arthas Menethil was the crown prince of Lordaeron who became the Lich King.
content: Arthas Menethil, son of King Terenas Menethil II, led the purge of Stratholme and pursued Mal'Ganis to Northrend, where he took up the runeblade Frostmourne. He returned to Lordaeron, killed his father and later merged with the Lich King Ner'zhul atop Icecrown Citadel.

title: Frostmourne
summary: Frostmourne is the runeblade of the Lich King.
content: Frostmourne was forged by the Lich King and left in Northrend for Arthas Menethil to find. The blade steals the souls of those it kills. It was shattered by Tirion Fordring at the Frozen Throne.

title: Sylvanas Windrunner
summary: Sylvanas Windrunner was Ranger-General of Silvermoon and later the Banshee Queen of the Forsaken.
content: Sylvanas defended Quel'Thalas against the Scourge and was killed and raised as a banshee by Arthas. After breaking free of the Lich King's control she founded the Forsaken in the ruins of Lordaeron and later became Warchief of the Horde.

title: Illidan Stormrage
summary: Illidan Stormrage is a night elf demon hunter, twin brother of Malfurion.
content: Illidan was imprisoned for ten thousand years for creating a new Well of Eternity. Freed during the Third War, he consumed the Skull of Gul'dan and later ruled Outland from the Black Temple.

title: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker
summary: Thunderfury is a legendary one-handed sword.
content: Thunderfury is crafted from the Bindings of the Windseeker, dropped by Garr and Baron Geddon in Molten Core, and requires defeating Prince Thunderaan.
